sections.Aims and Fit of Module: This module introduces the history of media, the principles of media aesthetics, and their application in media content creation. The aim of the module is to establish a solid foundation in the students’ appreciation of media aesthetics and basic methods to achieve visually-attractive output. This fundamental module will have a broad impact on their subsequent learnings and practices in later creative and practical modules.
sections.Learning outcomes: A. Understand the media history and various theories of media aesthetics B. Understand the principles of visual language C. Apply media aesthetics in the context of media content creation
sections.Method of teaching and learning: The teaching sessions are divided into two components: lectures and seminars.
